summary: Backend verification of the new MOCK-payment Premium subscription flow — ALL 12 PYTEST CHECKS PASS against the public preview URL. (1) GET /api/subscription/plans returns weekly (₹250/7d) and monthly (₹800/30d), currency=INR, no auth required. (2) Fresh guest → POST /subscribe {plan:'weekly'} returns mock_payment=true, sets is_premium=true, subscription_plan='weekly', subscription_expires_at ≈ now+7d (±120s); /auth/me reflects premium_source='subscription' and tool_uses_remaining=null; 12 consecutive /api/ai/tool calls all 200 (no 429). (3) Monthly subscribe → expiry ≈ now+30d, premium_source='subscription'. (4) Stacking: subscribe weekly twice on the same user → 2nd response expiry ≈ now+14d (extends from current expiry, not replaces). (5) Cancel: returns user.is_premium=false, subscription_plan=null, subscription_expires_at=null, premium_source=null, tool_uses_limit=10, tool_uses_remaining=10. (6) Admin precedence: admin /subscribe/cancel keeps is_premium=true and premium_source='admin'. (7) Whitelisted guest subscribes — premium_source remains 'admin' (admin takes precedence in projection per server.py:206-209). (8) Admin DELETE /api/admin/whitelist/<email> on a whitelisted+subscribed user: is_premium stays true, subscription_plan='monthly', premium_source flips to 'subscription' (admin grant cleared, paid sub keeps user premium). (9) Invalid plan 'yearly' → 400. (10) /subscribe and /cancel without bearer → 401. (11) Regression: non-premium 11th /api/ai/tool call → 429 with detail containing 'Daily limit' and '10/day'. Backend code review: _subscription_active correctly checked in admin_remove_whitelist (server.py:493); SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS const correct (server.py:136-139); _user_public premium_source priority is admin > subscription (server.py:206-209) — matches review request expectation.
critical_code_review_comments: subscribe() correctly stacks expiry: base = max(now, current_exp) + timedelta(days=info['days']) (server.py:522-525). Verified: 2 sequential weekly subscribes → ~14d expiry.

cancel() clears subscription_plan + expires_at then re-runs _ensure_whitelist_sync, which correctly re-derives is_premium from is_admin OR admin_granted OR sub_active (server.py:179-180). Admin/whitelisted users keep premium — verified.
admin_remove_whitelist (server.py:486-495) correctly checks _subscription_active before clearing is_premium, preserving paid users — verified.
premium_source projection: 'admin' if is_admin OR _admin_granted, else 'subscription' if _subscription_active, else None (server.py:206-209). Admin precedence on whitelisted+subscribed user verified.
mock_payment=true flag returned by /subscribe (server.py:540) — confirmed in TestSubscribeWeekly.
EXPO_BACKEND_URL env key is actually EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Test resolves either, but flagging in case frontend code or other tests assume the unprefixed name.
